appraisal_events.evidence: « Tu es un misérable, tu te plais à me torturer, à me faire faire des mensonges que je dis afin que tu me laisses tranquille. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette turns the exchange around and accuses Swann of tormenting her and forcing her into lies through his jealous interrogation, casting him as the aggressor within the scene.

status_effects.explanation: Within this exchange Odette successfully reframes Swann's insistent questioning as cruelty, putting him locally on the defensive, though the narrator's endorsement of this framing is uncertain given Odette's already-noted unreliability.
